::: {#def-null-deviance}

#### Null deviance

The **null deviance** is the [deviance](#def-deviance) of the model with an intercept and no other predictors.
Its fitted probability is the overall fraction $\bar\outvar$ of labels equal to $1$, so

$$
D_0 = -2 n \cb{\bar\outvar \ln \bar\outvar + \paren{1 - \bar\outvar} \ln\paren{1 - \bar\outvar}}.
$$ {#eq-null-deviance}

:::
